title: Return-volume dynamics in UK futures
summary: Different native targets and limited directional evidence; no trial.
about: Price-volume dynamics in three LIFFE futures contracts.
findings: Indexed description distinguishes volume/absolute-return links from limited signed-return prediction.
mechanism: Information arrival may link activity and volatility; this does not establish net directional gains.
build_on: No owned-target strategy; do not transfer UK findings to CME or confuse volatility prediction with return signs.
can_strategy_code_be_made: A faithful study requires original targets and methods; raw CME volume alone is insufficient.
reading_scope: Indexed bibliographic/abstract text only; related-article fragments not treated as this paper.
source_version: David Gordon McMillan and Alan Speight; Applied Financial Economics12(10),707–713,2002.
owned_input_mapping: LIFFE futures panel is not the owned CME design panel.
deeper_investigation: No full review or return work now.
